name: Felia Kanda Mondelicht
original_name: フェリア・神田＝モンデリヒト
source:
She is a genius girl who went to a university in Germany.

She is also quite famous worldwide as a researcher, and is the only teacher at the school to have completed a doctoral course. She is currently submitting her dissertation to an academic conference, and while waiting for the results, she is teaching on the side.

She is a teacher, but she is younger than her students. She is selfish, egoistic, arrogant, and super-cheeky. Basically, she thinks students are low-brained idiots who are no better than livestock.

Because of her genius, the test questions she makes are extremely difficult, and it is extremely difficult to get more than 10 points (of course, the perfect score is 100 points).

She thinks that the main character is no better than a monkey.

[From [url=http://www.love-juice.jp/takeout/new_kyousi.htm]official site[/url]]
